name: cheetah_pup_primitive_v0
status: Original provisional geometry and estimated component masses; not manufacturing CAD or a validated actuator simulation.
frame: Body x forward, y left, z up; roll about +x, pitch and knee about +y; meters, kilograms, radians.
mass_notes: Total 0.613 kg. Servo mass is the published XL330-M288-T 18 g value. All other entries are design allowances, not measured parts. Four roll motors are in the torso; four hip motors move with the roll brackets; four knee motors move with the upper links. Battery mass does not establish 10-15 minute runtime. Component inertias use simple envelopes, not measured CAD tensors.

actuator.model: ideal torque-limited position PD, for geometry and static screening only
actuator.notes: The 0.10 Nm value is a manufacturer-estimated continuous figure, not a thermal guarantee. Gains, damping and armature are arbitrary screening settings, not an identified XL330 model or BAM. Published BAM voltage/controller compatibility is still an open gate; do not use this model for sim-to-real training claims.

simulation.notes: Flat and carpet-placeholder surfaces are rigid planes. Friction values are assumptions. A threshold is a rigid 10 mm box. No measured carpet compliance or contact calibration. Robot self-collision is disabled: torso and links collide with terrain, motor envelopes are visual-only. Mechanical interference and collision-free joint workspace remain unvalidated.
